sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups all-green, led by Technology (momentum 0.867) and Energy (momentum 0.783), while defensive and rate-sensitive sectors continue to slide.

Technology and Energy retain dominant market leadership with momentum scores of 0.867 and 0.783, supported by Healthcare (0.750) and Communication Services (0.600) as the only groups gaining rank over the past five sessions. Technology and Communication Services stand out as the sole all-green sectors across all timeframes.

Meanwhile, Utilities (momentum 0.067) and Consumer Cyclical (momentum 0.217) remain deeply entrenched as momentum laggards. Rotating lower in rank are Financials, Real Estate, and Utilities, reflecting ongoing weakness in yield-sensitive segments.

## Strength
- Only 2 of 11 sectors maintain all-green breadth across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD: Technology and Communication Services.
- Technology leads overall momentum at 0.867 (rank 2), followed by Energy at 0.783 (rank 1).
- Healthcare shows strong absolute momentum at 0.750, holding the 5th rank YTD.

## Movers & Momentum
- Communication Services (+1 spot to rank 9; 0.60 momentum), Healthcare (+1 spot to rank 5; 0.75 momentum), and Consumer Defensive (+1 spot to rank 7; 0.40 momentum) showed the strongest 5-day rank improvements.
- Financials (-1 spot to rank 6; 0.55 momentum), Real Estate (-1 spot to rank 8; 0.27 momentum), and Utilities (-1 spot to rank 10; 0.07 momentum) were the sole groups losing rank.
- Consumer Cyclical holds the bottom position at rank 11 with weak momentum of 0.217.

## Divergences
- Communication Services holds all-green status across all timeframes despite sitting at a low YTD rank of 9 (momentum 0.600).
- Industrials shows an internal disconnect, carrying a strong YTD rank of 4 despite lagging momentum of 0.383.
- No fragile all-green early-warning signals are currently active across the groups.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare groups are surging up the ranks to join persistent energy and shipping leaders, while coal and uranium face sharp multi-day pullbacks.

Market leadership remains anchored by secular leaders in transport and energy, with Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.992, rank 2) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.957, rank 4) maintaining all-green profiles. However, rotation is heavily favoring healthcare: Diagnostics & Research (+26 spots to rank 44) and Health Information Services (+19 spots to rank 39) posted the largest five-day advances across all industries. 

Conversely, commodity energy outside refining is cracking. Coking Coal suffered the sharpest deterioration across the market, shedding 40 spots to rank 95, alongside steep declines in Uranium (-24 spots to rank 98) and Thermal Coal (-12 spots to rank 73). Early fading signals are also appearing in major fossil fuel spaces, as Oil & Gas Integrated and Oil & Gas E&P both experienced slight five-day rank slips despite elevated momentum.

## Strength
- **Narrow Breadth at the Top:** Only 17 of 144 groups exhibit all-green profiles across all tracked time horizons, anchored by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.992 momentum) and Marine Shipping (0.957 momentum).
- **Persistent Outperformers:** Groups sustaining top-36 ranks across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows include Consumer Electronics (0.910 momentum), Silver, Software - Infrastructure, and Insurance - Reinsurance.
- **Industrial and Tech Strength:** Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.874 momentum, rank 3) and Steel (0.87 momentum) continue to maintain positive performance across weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and YTD frames.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Healthcare Surges:** Diagnostics & Research gained 26 spots (rank 44, momentum 0.903) and Health Information Services gained 19 spots (rank 39, momentum 0.84), leading the five-day gainers alongside Specialty & Generic Drug Manufacturers (+17 spots, rank 79).
- **Severe Extractive Declines:** Coking Coal plummeted 40 spots to rank 95 (momentum 0.42), Uranium dropped 24 spots to rank 98 (momentum 0.23), and Thermal Coal dropped 12 spots to rank 73 (momentum 0.51).
- **Persistent Bottom Laggards:** Weakness remains concentrated in consumer and housing-related groups, with Mortgage Finance (momentum 0.083, rank 142) and Airports & Air Services (momentum 0.101, rank 140) anchoring the bottom of the momentum distribution.

## Divergences
- **Fading Leadership:** Several groups with solid momentum scores are losing ground over the short term, including Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.77, rank -1), Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.66, rank -2), and Utilities - Regulated Water (momentum 0.62, rank -5).
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Lower-momentum industries showing rapid short-term rank jumps include Real Estate - Development (+11 spots, momentum 0.40), Grocery Stores (+11 spots, momentum 0.46), and Aerospace & Defense (+7 spots, momentum 0.38).
